# CR-9202: Acme Manufacturing credit limit to $650,000

**Yes, it can be approved, but Sarah Chen cannot approve it.** Acme qualifies for $650,000 on its own standing. A limit above $500,000 needs **Elena Novak (Director of Finance)** to approve it and **Michael Torres (VP Sales)** to concur. Before the new limit is applied, Finance must also resolve CR-9201, an earlier request for the same customer that is still pending.

## The request

- **Request:** CR-9202 for ERP customer C-1001, raising the limit from $250,000 to $650,000.
- **Requested by:** Sarah Chen on 2026-09-23.
- **Justification:** Third-plant NS-500 ramp-up.
- **Basis:** The request relies on Acme's own standing. It does not cite a guarantee.
- **Not in the records I have:** The credit request extract does not contain CR-9202. It does contain **CR-9201**, also for C-1001 and dated the same day, raising the limit from $250,000 to $400,000. CR-9201 is still "Pending Approval."

## The customer

These records all describe the same company:
- ERP: C-1001, Acme Mfg. Holdings
- CRM: CRM-2048, Acme Manufacturing, tier **Strategic**

They share the same DUNS (04-812-7730) and address, and the agreement names Acme Mfg. Holdings "d/b/a Acme Manufacturing."

Acme Industrial Supply Co. (C-1044 / CRM-2091) is a different company and was not considered.

## Policy in force

Northstar Credit Policy 2026 applies, effective 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

## Payment history

The 2026 rule: no invoice due in the 12 months before the request may be paid or remain unpaid more than 30 days past its due date.

| Invoice | Due | Paid | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-60412 | 2025-11-28 | 2025-11-24 | On time |
| INV-62011 | 2026-07-25 | 2026-07-22 | On time |
| INV-62305 | 2026-10-02 | Unpaid | Not yet due on the request date, so it does not count |

No invoice breaks the rule.

## Maximum limit

- The Strategic maximum is **$750,000**, and $650,000 is within it.
- The parent guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 ($400,000, in force 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31, naming Acme Mfg. Holdings) would raise the maximum to $1,150,000. It is not needed for this request.

## Who must approve

- **Sarah Chen** is an Enterprise Account Executive. The credit policy gives her role no approval authority.
- **Approval:** $650,000 is above $500,000, so the **Director of Finance, Elena Novak**, must approve.
- **Concurrence:** Acme is a Strategic account above $500,000, so the **VP Sales, Michael Torres**, must concur.
- **Separation of duties:** Neither Elena Novak nor Michael Torres submitted the request, so the rule does not change who approves.

## Decision: APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION

```json
{
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "CR-9202", "customer": "Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001) / Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048)", "current_limit": 250000, "requested_limit": 650000,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen (sarah.chen@northstar.example)", "basis": "standard"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 750000,
                  "basis": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 §5: Strategic account maximum $750,000 (CRM-2048 tier Strategic); no invoice due 2025-09-23 to 2026-09-23 paid or unpaid more than 30 days past due. Guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 not relied on.",
                  "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Director of Finance, with VP Sales concurrence (Strategic account, limit > $500,000)",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Elena Novak", "role": "Director of Finance", "kind": "approval"},
                              {"name": "Michael Torres", "role": "VP Sales", "kind": "concurrence"}]},
  "evidence": ["CREDIT-POLICY-2026 §3, §4, §5, §6", "structured/customers.csv C-1001", "structured/crm_accounts.csv CRM-2048 (Strategic, DUNS 04-812-7730)", "structured/erp_credit.csv C-1001 limit 250000", "structured/erp_invoices.csv INV-60412, INV-62011, INV-62305", "structured/employees.csv and ORG-CHART-2026-09 (role holders)", "GRT-ACME-2026 (noted, not relied on)", "structured/credit_requests.csv CR-9201 (pending, same customer)"],
  "missing_evidence": ["CR-9202 does not appear in the credit_requests extract provided"],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "CR-9201 (C-1001, $250,000 to $400,000, Pending Approval, same date and requestor) must be withdrawn or marked superseded by CR-9202 before the new limit is applied, so the two pending requests do not conflict", "who": "Sarah Chen / Finance (Elena Novak)", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Confirm CR-9202 is recorded in Northstar ERP; it is absent from the credit_requests extract reviewed", "who": "Finance", "blocking": false},
    {"what": "Open invoice INV-62305 ($720,000, due 2026-10-02) was unpaid as of the request and is now past due as of 2026-10-06; approvers may wish to review current exposure", "who": "Elena Novak", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
